text.apotheosis.world_tier.frontier.desc: Venture forth into the dangerous world
tutorial.apotheosis.world_tier.tier_diff:
This is the difficulty of the selected World Tier. Higher difficulties mean stronger mobs, but also better rewards.

At World Tier: Venture and above, Apothic Invaders will begin to spawn in your world.
advancements.apotheosis.progression.root:
Milestones for unlocking World Tiers. Your tier rises by itself as you beat chapter bosses.
Press CTRL+T to see the details
advancements.apotheosis.progression.fron: Defeat the Amethyst Crab and earn a Geode Claw
advancements.apotheosis.progression.asce: Defeat The Harbinger and earn the Nether Sigil
advancements.apotheosis.progression.summ: Defeat Ignis and earn the Void Shard
advancements.apotheosis.progression.pinn: Defeat the Ender Guardian and the Ender Dragon
